mentions.name: hackernews.coffee
mentions.description: This tool reranks the Hacker News frontpage based on the user's interests rather than just trending content. It builds a personal profile from a small number of selected past articles and keeps both the profile and how it produces recommendations transparent and editable, so users stay in control of what 'personal' looks like.
mentions.problem: People want personal content systems, but there is a lack of ones where they stay in control of what 'personal' actually looks like, given the prevalence of opaque LLM-powered tools and black-box recommendation algorithms.
mentions.source_excerpt: Continuing to work on https://www.hackernews.coffee/ to rerank the HN frontpage based on my interests, not just what's trending.
